scope: Two browser interactions on one previously reviewed Abu Dhabi photo. This checks zoom, coordinate mapping and what the app tells the passenger after a manually chosen point. It is a development replay.
view_limits: Desktop Edge received a mouse click. A 390 by 844 Edge viewport received an emulated touch. Both used the displayed source at 2x zoom. A separate browser regression exercised a pan before tapping and confirmed no write until Check this point.
